description: The file defines the 'Reward' class within the Opencart system, specifically in the API sale controller namespace. It contains methods to handle reward points, including retrieving and updating reward points, calculating maximum reward points, and checking reward point availability. The class interacts with the customer session, shopping cart, and request/response handling to process reward-related API calls.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: API controller class for managing reward points, including fetching, updating, and validating reward points for a user during a sale process.

methods.description: Returns the current reward points available for the customer.
